# zoneblick

> zoneblick is a self-hosted DNS zone watchdog, written in Rust. It resolves each zone from the root, asks every authoritative nameserver directly, checks the answers for correctness and risk, and reports what changed. It is open source and runs on your own server; it is not a hosted service.

Status as of 2026-11-13: early development. Three things work: `zoneblick check <zone>` checks a zone once with the delegation, consistency and DNSSEC checks (the DNSSEC checks are beta and do not yet verify signatures); `zoneblick run <zone> --name <name>` also collects the records of listed names and stores each run in a SQLite file; `zoneblick diff <zone>` shows what changed between two stored runs, per nameserver. The scheduler, alerts, the web UI, and the mail-policy and takeover checks are designed but not built yet. The current release is v0.3.0, an early pre-release. Each release has ready-built binaries on the GitHub releases page (https://github.com/cschweda/zoneblick/releases) for Linux (x86_64 and ARM 64-bit, static), macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, unsigned) and 64-bit Windows (unsigned). It can also be built from source with a stable Rust toolchain (1.88 or later): `cargo install --git https://github.com/cschweda/zoneblick`. The name is always written in lowercase.

Key facts:

- Author: Christopher Schweda
- Language: Rust
- License: MIT or Apache-2.0, at your option
- Source code: https://github.com/cschweda/zoneblick
- It queries authoritative nameservers itself, over UDP and TCP, IPv4 and IPv6. It never trusts a recursive resolver's cache.
- It is meant for zones you control. It is not an offensive or scanning tool.

## Site

- [Home](https://zoneblick.com/): what DNS drift is, what zoneblick checks, how a run works, and how it differs from existing tools
- [Demo](https://zoneblick.com/demo.html): the planned web interface, shown with sample data only

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/cschweda/zoneblick/blob/main/README.md): how to try the `check` command, exit codes, and the JSON output format
- [Design document](https://github.com/cschweda/zoneblick/blob/main/DESIGN.md): goals, architecture, the full check catalog, data model and build phases
- [Decisions](https://github.com/cschweda/zoneblick/blob/main/DECISIONS.md): choices made during implementation, one line each

## Optional

- [Zonemaster](https://zonemaster.net): deep one-shot delegation and DNSSEC analysis; zoneblick does not aim for parity
- [DNSViz](https://dnsviz.net): DNSSEC chain visualisation
